defs.def: further forward in space or time; in front （时间、空间）向前面，在前面

ex.s: When Nick runs ahead, I hear him barking excitedly.
ex.t: 如果你有不支持的人，你的话可能不会有太大作用，而且往往让你感到更加沮丧。

ex.s: “I am ahead of my time.” If he seems a little defensive, it might be because even some of his coworkers occasionally laugh at his unusual methods.
ex.t: 我走在时代前面。”如果他显得有点戒备，或许是因为连他的一些同事偶尔也会嘲笑他那不寻常的方法。

ex.s: She stopped thinking about the word “mile.” Instead, she focused on reaching the shadow cast on the track by an oak tree up ahead.
ex.t: 她不再去想"英里"这个词。相反，她专注于跑到前方一棵橡树投在跑道上的影子处。

ex.s: They will be moving on the track ahead of the train, and programmed to run autonomously.
ex.t: 它们将在列车前方的轨道上行驶，并被编程为自主运行。

ex.s: With their ability to see ahead, they could signal any problem, so that fast-moving trains would be able to react in time.
ex.t: 凭借它们的前瞻能力，它们可以发出任何问题的信号，以便高速行驶的火车能及时反应。

ex.s: Fearing that I would pick out something awful, I desperately tried to ask the boy ahead of me for a recommendation.
ex.t: 担心会挑到难吃的东西，我拼命想请前面的男孩推荐一下。

ex.s: I awoke early the next morning,  22  of the uncertain days ahead.
ex.t: 第二天清晨我很早就醒了，22 着前方不确定的日子。

ex.s: Although popular beliefs regarding emotional intelligence run far ahead of what research can reasonably support, the overall effects of the publicity have been more beneficial than harmful.
ex.t: 情商的普及有助于公众和研究人员重新评估情感的功能以及它们如何在日常生活中帮助人们适应。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: Atomic time will get ahead of river time if the rivers run slower．
ex.t: 如果河流流速减慢，原子时间将提前到达河流时间。

ex.s: B．Those who tend to think back can hardly go ahead．
ex.t: B．那些倾向于回顾过去的人几乎无法前进。

ex.s: Exercising makes you more awake and ready to handle whatever is ahead of you for the day.
ex.t: 锻炼使你更加清醒，准备好应对当天面临的任何事情。

ex.s: We reached the stream, and they unwillingly walked ahead.
ex.t: 我们到达了小溪，他们不情愿地继续往前走。

ex.s: Yet, I was determined to go ahead.
ex.t: 到了3英里处，我看到一个标志："加油，跑步者们！"

ex.s: Ahead of its time, the submarine is also a secret from the rest of the world.
ex.t: 这艘潜艇超前于它所处的时代，对世界其他地方来说也是一个秘密。

ex.s: While there might be more hospital visits ahead for Lara and others, I hope that clown doctors help make it a friendlier place to visit.
ex.t: 虽然Lara和其他人可能会有更多的医院就诊机会，但我希望小丑医生能帮助它成为一个更友好的就诊场所。

ex.s: Lang is only too aware that as soon as a team steps off the victory podium, they need to start from zero to prepare for new challenges ahead.
ex.t: Lang非常清楚，一旦团队走出胜利领奖台，他们就需要从零开始，为未来的新挑战做好准备。

ex.s: Lang knows only too well that a team needs to start from zero to prepare for new challenges ahead after ranking at the top.
ex.t: Lang非常清楚，团队需要从零开始，以便在排名第一之后为未来的新挑战做好准备。

ex.s: Some of these ideas may sound far ahead of their time, but I’m sure they’re bound to happen sooner or later!
ex.t: 其中一些想法听起来可能远远超出了他们的时代，但我相信它们迟早会发生！

ex.s: If you enter through the wrong access point, you'll be turned around and redirected — so plan ahead.
ex.t: 如果你从错误的入口进入，会被拦下并重新指引——所以请提前规划。

defs.def: winning; further advanced 占优势；领先

ex.s: However, while some of her classmates edged ahead, others actually fell behind.
ex.t: 然而，虽然她的一些同学逐渐领先，但其他人实际上落后了。

ex.s: Very small drones with advanced sensors and AI and travelling ahead of the train could guide it like a co-pilot.
ex.t: 带有先进传感器和AI、在火车前方行驶的小型无人机，可以像副驾驶一样为它引路。
